title: 2024 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Carlos Sainz / Lucas Cruz (Team Audi Sport) and Ricky Brabec (Monster Energy Honda Team)
summary: The 2024 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its Saudi Arabia era: 10 stage towns and bivouacs through Saudi Arabia. Winners — Cars: Carlos Sainz / Lucas Cruz (Team Audi Sport); Bikes: Ricky Brabec (Monster Energy Honda Team); Quads: Manuel Andújar (7240 Team); Challenger: Cristina Gutiérrez / Pablo Moreno Huete (Red Bull Off-Road JR Team USA By BFG); SSVs: Xavier de Soultrait / Martin Bonnet (Sébastien Loeb Racing - Bardahl Team).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
